# stereo-motion
> Makes transparent stereoscopic (side-by-side) video material from one image: a camera sways or circles around depth estimated in the browser. Transparent PNG in -> transparent WebM (VP9 alpha) out; opaque image -> MP4. Runs only on this PC.

- [Guide for AI agents](docs/FOR-AI.md): tools, arguments, results, examples (MCP, local HTTP API and CLI share the same definitions)
- [README](README.md): what it is, how to run
